form.label: Outbound Connections to External IPs - Servers

search.query: | tstats summariesonly=true fillnull_value="N/A" count FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Ports WHERE (sourcetype="*sysmon*" OR sourcetype="*XmlWinEventLog*") Ports.dest_port!=53 Ports.dest_port!=0 BY Ports.dest_ip Ports.EventCode Ports.Initiated | rename Ports.* AS * | where dest_ip!="N/A" | where NOT (tostring(EventCode)="3" AND lower(Initiated)!="true") | where NOT ( cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("169.254.0.0/16", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("100.64.0.0/10", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("224.0.0.0/4", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("fc00::/7", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("fe80::/10", dest_ip) OR dest_ip="0.0.0.0" OR dest_ip="255.255.255.255" OR dest_ip="::1" OR dest_ip="::" OR dest_ip="0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1" ) | stats sum(count) as total | fillnull value=0 total

| tstats summariesonly=true fillnull_value="N/A" count FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Ports WHERE (sourcetype="*sysmon*" OR sourcetype="*XmlWinEventLog*") Ports.dest_port!=53 Ports.dest_port!=0 BY Ports.dest Ports.dest_ip Ports.EventCode Ports.Initiated | rename Ports.* AS * | where dest_ip!="N/A" | where NOT (tostring(EventCode)="3" AND lower(Initiated)!="true") | where NOT ( cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("169.254.0.0/16", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("100.64.0.0/10", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("224.0.0.0/4", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("fc00::/7", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("fe80::/10", dest_ip) OR dest_ip="0.0.0.0" OR dest_ip="255.255.255.255" OR dest_ip="::1" OR dest_ip="::" OR dest_ip="0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1" ) | stats dc(dest) as hosts | fillnull value=0 hosts

panel.title: Windows - Outbound Connections to External IPs (Sysmon EventCode 3 only with Initiated=true)

search.query: | tstats summariesonly=true fillnull_value="N/A" count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Ports WHERE (sourcetype="*sysmon*" OR sourcetype="*XmlWinEventLog*") Ports.dest_port!=53 Ports.dest_port!=0 BY Ports.dest Ports.user Ports.process_name Ports.dest_ip Ports.dest_port Ports.src Ports.EventCode Ports.Initiated | rename Ports.* AS * | where dest_ip!="N/A" | where NOT (tostring(EventCode)="3" AND lower(Initiated)!="true") | where NOT ( cidrmatch("10.0.0.0/8", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("172.16.0.0/12", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("192.168.0.0/16", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("127.0.0.0/8", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("169.254.0.0/16", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("100.64.0.0/10", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("224.0.0.0/4", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("fc00::/7", dest_ip) OR cidrmatch("fe80::/10", dest_ip) OR dest_ip="0.0.0.0" OR dest_ip="255.255.255.255" OR dest_ip="::1" OR dest_ip="::" OR dest_ip="0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1" ) | sort 0 - last_seen | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table first_seen last_seen dest user process_name dest_ip dest_port EventCode Initiated src count
